name: stashwise
description: Proactively ground recommendations, strategy, planning, comparisons, research, and recall in the user's private Stashwise saves, even when Stashwise is not mentioned.

interface.shortDescription: Bring your saved research into every answer
interface.longDescription: Searches the user's private Stashwise library and wiki before substantive recommendation, strategy, planning, comparison, research, or recall answers whenever saved material may help, even when they do not mention Stashwise. Retrieves full context before relying on a result, combines saved research with current web evidence rather than replacing it, and writes only on explicit request.
defaultPrompt: What have I saved about this topic?
Save this research to my Stashwise library
